concerns.text: The summary lists T007 (harmonize) as a foundational task before T006 (download). This places a consumer before its producer, violating the required data‑flow order.

There is no task that computes and records SHA‑256 checksums for the raw poll files downloaded by T006. Constitution III mandates checksumming of all raw datasets, so a producer task for raw‑data hashes is missing.
T007 appears twice—once in the ‘Foundation’ list and again in the ‘Data ingestion’ sequence—creating a duplicate entry that can cause confusion.
